findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally allows a user to read documents belonging to another tenant. The previous implementation required `userTenant === documentTenant`, so this change creates a cross-tenant authorization bypass wherever this function guards document access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality before granting document reads
findings.body:
Any caller relying on this authorization check now permits cross-tenant document access whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, potentially exposing tenant-isolated data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant whenever this exported authorization function guards access, causing a complete cross-tenant authorization bypass and potential sensitive-data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
